name: Union Pacific Corporation
hero_kpi_rationale: Métrique clé d'efficacité opérationnelle pour les chemins de fer, reflétant la capacité à contrôler les coûts d'exploitation relativement aux revenus. Union Pacific vise un ratio d'exploitation de classe mondiale pour créer de la valeur à long terme.

kpis.description_fr: Volumes carloads. Décomposé Premium (intermodal, auto), Bulk (grain, coal), Industrial (chemicals, metals). Sensible PIB US.
kpis.description_en: Carload volumes. Premium (intermodal, auto), Bulk (grain, coal), Industrial (chemicals, metals). Tied to US GDP.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu moyen par carload. Pricing + mix + fuel surcharge. Pricing core +3-4%/an, partiellement offset fuel.
kpis.description_en: Avg revenue per carload. Pricing + mix + fuel surcharge. Core pricing +3-4%/yr, partly offset by fuel.

kpis.description_fr: Operating Ratio ajusté (OpEx / Revenue). KPI clé railroads, plus bas = mieux. UNP pression post Vena Whited PSR. Cible <58%.
kpis.description_en: Adj Operating Ratio (OpEx/Revenue). Key railroad KPI, lower = better. UNP under pressure post Vena Whited PSR. <58% target.

kpis.description_fr: Vitesse moyenne réseau. Indicateur service + efficiency. Cible 26+ mph. Suit STB scrutiny + PSR cycle.
kpis.description_en: Network average train speed. Service + efficiency indicator. 26+ mph target. STB scrutiny + PSR cycle.

kpis.description_fr: Mix intermodal. Croissance attendu via near-shoring Mexique + truck-to-rail shift. Concurrence CSX/NSC.
kpis.description_en: Intermodal mix. Growth expected via Mexico nearshoring + truck-to-rail shift. CSX/NSC competition.

evidence: The rapid evolution and increased availability of artificial intelligence may intensify cybersecurity risks by making cyber-attacks more sophisticated and cybersecurity incidents more difficult to detect, contain, and mitigate.

A cyber incident that results in significant service interruption; safety failure; other operational difficulties; unauthorized access to (or the loss of access to) competitively sensitive, confidential, or other critical data or systems; loss of customers; financial losses; regulatory fines; reputational harm; or misuse or corruption of critical data and proprietary information, could have a material adverse impact on our results of operations, financial condition, and liquidity.
ai_positioning.summary: UNP adopte une posture défensive face à l'IA, la percevant principalement comme un vecteur de risque cybersécuritaire accru. La société exprime des préoccupations quant à la sophistication croissante des attaques facilitées par l'IA et leurs impacts potentiels sur ses opérations.

company_description: Union Pacific Corporation, through its subsidiary, Union Pacific Railroad Company, operates in the railroad business in the United States. It offers transportation services for grain and grain products, fertilizers, food and refrigerated products, and coal and renewables to grain processors, animal feeders, and ethanol and renewable biofuel producers; and construction products, industrial chemicals, plastics, forest products, specialized products, metals and ores, petroleum, liquid petroleum gases, soda ash, and sand, as well as finished automobiles, automotive parts, and merchandise in intermodal containers. The company was founded in 1862 and is headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska.
